name: Perudo (Card Variant)
description: Perudo (also known as Liar's Dice when played with dice) is a world-famous game of bluffing, probability, and nerve. This card-based adaptation replaces the dice cups with hidden hands of cards. Players must guess how many cards of a certain rank (e.g., 'Five Kings') are held collectively by everyone at the table. It is a game of extreme deception where you can win with the worst hand if you can successfully convince others you have the best.

content.text: Perudo (also known as Liar's Dice when played with dice) is a world-famous game of bluffing, probability, and nerve. This card-based adaptation replaces the dice cups with hidden hands of cards. Players must guess how many cards of a certain rank (e.g., 'Five Kings') are held collectively by everyone at the table. It is a game of extreme deception where you can win with the worst hand if you can successfully convince others you have the best.

Rooted in the ancient game 'Dudo' from South America (Inca Empire), popularized globally as Perudo by Richard Blom in the 1980s. The card variant emerged as a portable alternative for those without dice sets.
Each player is dealt 5 cards face-down. Do NOT show them to anyone.

items.text: Calza: If a player calls the exact count (Calza) when challenging, they may regain one card instead of the usual resolution.
